project: RISO21 Courier and Paper Artist native two-spot eye study

sources.title: Fish Guts Press · physical Risograph print with close-up blue/pink eyes
sources.creator: Fish Guts Press; original illustration attribution requires confirmation
sources.rights: third-party; reference observation only; no tracing or redistribution

analysis.construction: Two nonidentical oblique eye openings; inner canthus is a small asymmetrical transition, not a circular bead. Iris contours disappear under upper lids.
analysis.material: Cobalt/pink screen overlap; white of eye stays paper; dots follow spot plates rather than RGB blur
analysis.microdetail: Narrow changing-width upper lash roots, mixed-scale curved under-eye tone transitions, visible ink-dot tooth
analysis.light: Local paper reserve at sclera reads as stronger light than any translucent white overlay

crops.observation: Blue iris is partially covered by a changing-width lid; pink printed grain transitions into papery cheek, with a distinct lower orbital arc
crops.implementation_rule: Retain authored main eye; add separately rigged canthus/lash and red screened lower orbit, no full-face grain

sources.title: TAROT ZINE · ink portrait with close detailed eye engraving
sources.creator: Original Behance illustrator; creator metadata not independently confirmed
sources.medium: printed / screen-like limited palette editorial illustration; exact printing process not independently verified

analysis.construction: Asymmetric upper eyelid arches with intentional pointed canthi, lower rim wedge and distinct brow planes
analysis.material: Strong dark line art over broad bright midtone; local hatching in the socket not uniform whole-face halftone
analysis.microdetail: Short nested eyelid marks, converging brow hair lines and tapered lower-eye hatches
analysis.light: Negative paper/bright plane reserved inside open iris and lid regions

crops.observation: Upper lash feathering roots into eyelid stroke; dark lower orbital lines change spacing and bend under an off-centre iris
crops.implementation_rule: Use named semantic eye contours with four independent expressive states, preserve paper-backed face

sources.title: Kat Schneider · Pride & Prejudice Hands mini Risograph
sources.creator: Kat Schneider

analysis.construction: Distinct rooted anatomy of knuckles/fingers in two-panel print
analysis.material: Physical ink grain and unprinted paper break forms

feature_targets.geometry_rule: Original head-frame eye geometry remains source of truth; four independently named and blink-aware split-plate contours
feature_targets.test_view: both original actors at 46, 78, 160, 198 in 16:9 and 9:16
feature_targets.source_observation: Source detail hierarchy is qualitative; no authorized individual portrait or full-res aligned print scan was supplied, so identity/pixel likeness is not established.

feature_targets.geometry_rule: Original narrower, more upturned Paper Artist eye apertures preserved; newly authored facets are not copies of the Courier.
microdetails: stronger off-centre printed iris tonal areas
feature_targets.test_view: neutral / blink / speak / smile; both spot separations and portrait/landscape
feature_targets.source_observation: Style-guided only. Source faces are not identity references for the original actors, and no source pixel masks can honestly be passed.
